<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 92" width="600" height="92" preserveAspectRatio="xMaxYMid slice">
  <style>
    .dash { animation: flow 1.6s linear infinite; }
    .sent { animation: sent 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .reply { animation: reply 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .tick { animation: tick 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .static { display: none; }
    @keyframes flow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -14 } }
    @keyframes sent { 0%,100% { opacity: .35 } 8%,60% { opacity: .65 } }
    @keyframes reply { 0%,62% { opacity: .2 } 70%,92% { opacity: .8 } 100% { opacity: .2 } }
    @keyframes tick { 0%,70% { opacity: 0 } 76%,92% { opacity: .7 } 100% { opacity: 0 } }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .dash, .sent, .reply, .tick { animation: none }
      .sent { opacity: .65 } .reply { opacity: .8 } .tick { opacity: .6 }
      .motion { display: none } .static { display: inline }
    }
  </style>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="75%" cy="50%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9500FF" stop-opacity="0.24"/>
